Finisar FTL410QE2C QSFP+ 40GBASE-SR4 40Gbps Optical Transceiver Module – D CORE


The Finisar FTL410QE2C is a high-performance 40GBASE-SR4 QSFP+ Optical Transceiver designed for short-range 40Gbps Ethernet applications over multimode fiber (MMF). Operating at 850nm, this module uses 12-fiber MTP/MPO connectors, enabling reliable 40G data transmission up to 100 meters on OM3 and 150 meters on OM4 fiber.


Built with Finisar’s industry-leading optical components, the FTL410QE2C ensures excellent signal integrity, low power consumption, and seamless compatibility with major networking brands such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Brocade, Dell, HP, and others.


Perfect for data centers, enterprise networks, spine-leaf architecture, server uplinks, and high-bandwidth aggregation, this module delivers outstanding performance and stability.


Key Features


  • Supports 40GBASE-SR4 40Gbps Ethernet
  • Uses MTP/MPO-12 connector
  • Up to 100m on OM3 and 150m on OM4
  • Operates at 850 nm VCSEL laser
  • QSFP+ hot-pluggable design
  • Low latency & low power consumption
  • Fully compliant with IEEE 802.3ba
  • Supports Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM)
  • Compatible with Cisco, Juniper, Arista, HP, Dell, Huawei, etc.
  • Ideal for high-density 40G data center environments
